_about: One release entry in the release format, written by scripts/release-runs.py from real runs of two builds. The commands, output lines, exit codes, result files, builds and footer come from the raw record in site/changelog/logs/; whole lines are cut to fit by the fixture, no line is edited. Only date, label, headline, lead, next.note and film are written by hand.
label: Behavior change
headline: sweep now continues the sorting you already started

lead.text: is already there, sweep 0.5.5 moves one or two matching files into it and exits with code 0. Version 0.5.4 left those 2 files where they were and exited with code 1.

output: 2 files matched no group and were left where they are

note.text: A new folder still needs 3 or more files. No flag needed. To put the 2 files back, run

footer: Both outputs come from real runs of two builds: tag sweep-v0.5.4 (commit de8f307) and the 0.5.5 release candidate at commit a0ea3af, not tagged yet. Each ran the same commands on a fresh copy of one synthetic folder, inbox: a Documents folder with 3 PDFs, and 2 new PDFs loose next to it. Output is shortened to fit by cutting whole lines. Nothing outside the scratch folder was touched.
